$comment: Machine-only standards config read by the pooling engine (build-hmtc-aggregate-distributions.mjs), keyed by product_slug. It carries two decisions that must NOT live in public wiki/products/ frontmatter (both are Part-2 firewall leaks there): the clean/dirty/independent ROLE, and whether the row's pool is restricted to the certification-relevant market (STRATIFY). Rows absent from `roles` keep default behaviour: independent P97, full (unstratified) pool.
$stratify_comment: `stratify: true` restricts a row's pool to the jurisdictions in `target_markets` on EVERY build (no CLI flag needed) — this is how a ratified methodology change is made concrete for a category without a hand-run flag. Stratification is rolled out PER-CATEGORY as each is validated, deliberately NOT as a global default: a blanket flip empties ~100 cells across the corpus (salt, lipstick, coffee, canned-seafood tin, etc.) whose evidence base is entirely non-target-market, which would regress those categories. The `--markets` CLI flag still overrides this for ad-hoc analysis and forces stratification on all rows.
target_markets_criterion: Regulatory-equivalence, NOT geography: jurisdictions that enforce binding maximum levels for infant/young-child formula with comparable surveillance. This list is the operational expression of that criterion; the criterion, not the country list, is what may be published. Sources with no jurisdiction recorded are retained, not dropped.

infant-formula-powder-non-soy.rationale: Cow-milk-based powdered formula is the clean benchmark of the infant-formula-powder within-matrix pair. Clean subcategory is held to P97 of its own occurrence distribution, calibrated to admit ~90% of well-controlled brands at the row level. Pool restricted to the certification-relevant market.

infant-formula-powder-soy-based.rationale: Soy-protein-isolate powdered formula is the higher-contamination sibling. Dirty subcategory is held to P45 of its own occurrence distribution: a demanding per-analyte target admitting only the cleanest brands at the row level (~40% row-pass, measured), so the certification ratchets the segment toward cleaner product. Final per-analyte limit is min(P45, lowest applicable regulatory cap). Pool restricted to the certification-relevant market.

roles._cat3_note: Category 3 (Grains, Cereals, and Rice Products) roles. Phase-0 clean/dirty structure derived deterministically from taxonomy hmtc-v2.json (n=3): 'Rice is a known contamination platform for iAs, Cd, and Pb. Non-rice grains are the clean counterpart', with the rice/non-rice explicit pairs the taxonomy maintains for the Clean Counterpart Cap. IMPORTANT: Cat-3 was built with HMTc Method v2.0 GOVERNMENT-LIMIT DEFAULT and occurrence pooling is NOT invoked (the government MLs are the defensible anchors and the rice-occurrence pool is known-contaminated — censored-zero/p95/x7-basis artifacts). Therefore target_percentile and stratify below are DOCUMENTARY placeholders that record the intended clean/dirty treatment should pooling ever be validated for this category; they are not consumed by any live Cat-3 computation. stratify is left false (not yet validated per-category per the ratified per-category rollout rule). authorized_by records the derivation source pending Karen's confirmation, not a prior sign-off.

flour-non-rice.rationale: Non-rice wheat/corn/other flour. Clean counterpart in the grain platform: inorganic arsenic is not-material (does not hyperaccumulate in non-rice cereals). Government MLs bind (Pb, Cd, tHg, Ni); occurrence pooling not invoked.
flour-non-rice.authorized_by: taxonomy hmtc-v2.json n=3 + Cat-3 standard build session

bread-and-baked-goods.rationale: Non-rice baked goods. Clean counterpart; iAs not-material. Government MLs bind.
bread-and-baked-goods.authorized_by: taxonomy hmtc-v2.json n=3 + Cat-3 standard build session

pasta-wheat-based.rationale: Clean sibling of the pasta within-form pair (wheat vs rice). iAs not-material in wheat pasta; the rice sibling carries the binding iAs ML.
pasta-wheat-based.authorized_by: taxonomy hmtc-v2.json n=3 + Cat-3 standard build session

pasta-rice-based.rationale: Dirty sibling of the pasta pair. Rice hyperaccumulates iAs; binding iAs ML = EU 2023/915 rice-flour/parboiled 250 ppb. Clean Counterpart Cap references pasta-wheat-based.
pasta-rice-based.authorized_by: taxonomy hmtc-v2.json n=3 + Cat-3 standard build session

breakfast-cereal-non-rice.rationale: Clean sibling of the breakfast-cereal within-form pair. iAs not-material.
breakfast-cereal-non-rice.authorized_by: taxonomy hmtc-v2.json n=3 + Cat-3 standard build session

breakfast-cereal-rice-based.rationale: Dirty sibling of the breakfast-cereal pair. Binding iAs ML = EU 2023/915 rice products/flakes 300 ppb. Clean Counterpart Cap references breakfast-cereal-non-rice.
breakfast-cereal-rice-based.authorized_by: taxonomy hmtc-v2.json n=3 + Cat-3 standard build session

grain-based-snacks.rationale: Clean (non-rice) counterpart of the snack within-form pair (crackers/biscuits/cookies/popcorn/pretzels). iAs not-material.
grain-based-snacks.authorized_by: taxonomy hmtc-v2.json n=3 + Cat-3 standard build session

rice-snacks-crackers.rationale: Dirty sibling of the snack pair (rice cakes/wafers/crackers). Binding iAs ML = EU 2023/915 rice products 300 ppb. Clean Counterpart Cap references grain-based-snacks.
rice-snacks-crackers.authorized_by: taxonomy hmtc-v2.json n=3 + Cat-3 standard build session

rice-bulk-grain.rationale: The raw rice platform (white/brown/wild). Independent dirty anchor of the category. Binding iAs ML = EU 2023/915 non-parboiled milled rice 150 ppb (white rice; EU splits milled 150 / husked 250 — strictest adopted).
rice-bulk-grain.authorized_by: taxonomy hmtc-v2.json n=3 + Cat-3 standard build session

rice-noodles.rationale: Rice-flour noodle product; independent dirty (no distinct wheat-noodle subcategory exists — wheat noodles route to pasta-wheat-based). Binding iAs ML = EU 2023/915 rice-flour 250 ppb.
rice-noodles.authorized_by: taxonomy hmtc-v2.json n=3 + Cat-3 standard build session

other-grain-products.rationale: Oat/millet/quinoa/barley; independent clean (non-rice). iAs not-material. Note: a single-value ceiling bundles grains with materially different EU Cd (barley/rye 50, quinoa 150) and Ni (barley 800, millet/quinoa 3000, oats 5000) MLs; the standard adopts the strictest constituent (Cd 50, Ni 800) as the ratchet, disclosed.
other-grain-products.authorized_by: taxonomy hmtc-v2.json n=3 + Cat-3 standard build session

rice-beverages-rice-milk.rationale: Rice milk / rice-based drink (as-consumed liquid); independent dirty. Binding iAs ML = EU 2023/915 non-alcoholic rice-based drinks 30 ppb (the sole binding cell; Pb/Cd are material but no government sets a rice-drink ML — no-ML-confirmed).
rice-beverages-rice-milk.authorized_by: taxonomy hmtc-v2.json n=3 + Cat-3 standard build session
